beats.summary: Dwight tricks Erin into saying she won an art contest and laughs hysterically.

evidence.snippet: Erin: Oh my God! I can't believe it! I jut won an art contest!

beats.summary: Michael tries to get coworkers to have lunch with him but they all decline.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Oh, I can't do lunch. I was just sending you an email. Jim and I need to leave early today to meet with our contractor.

beats.summary: Pam and Jim reveal they are getting married today in Ohio to avoid a waiting period.

evidence.snippet: Jim: So, it turns out it's the closest place to get a marriage license without a 3 day waiting period.

beats.summary: Michael creates a 'cafe disco' downstairs as a place for employees to hang out and have fun.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I've taken my downstairs office and I have turned it into a place to hang out.

beats.summary: Michael encourages employees to come to the cafe disco with promises of espresso and fun.
